name: Gilly
title: Keeper of the Five Stones
examine: Walked the road as far as Saltmere and came home to pour for the ones just starting it. Every guest bed made square, every story half a mile long.
lines: Claim a bed before you claim a road. The bed remembers you. Roads don't.
I've seen Saltmere. Grey gulls, painted boats, salt in everything including the gossip.
Four beds in the wing, and every one of them has carried somebody who's somebody now.
